resources.string: These choices are local drafts restored with this screen. Booking, membership and invitations are unavailable until the service is connected.
No services are available. Return later to choose a service.
Live slots, capacity and reservation rules are not connected. You can prepare a preferred date and time; neither is a confirmed slot.
No confirmed appointments can be loaded. Local preferences are not reservations.
Reservation details require a confirmed reservation. Cancellation and rescheduling stay unavailable; changing your local preference does not change a booking.
Prepare a holder label and member labels. Do not enter private identifiers. Individual tickets remain separate.
Members — one local label per line
Use labels only; do not enter identification numbers or private contact details. These labels are not verified identities.
Enter a holder label and at least one member label to review this local draft.
Enter at least one member label.
No group ticket is linked. There is no serving status or saved membership to display.
Edit or clear the local draft below. Adding, removing or leaving real group membership needs an approved group contract and connected service.
Only the queue owner can open this screen. No staff membership or privileges are granted here. Trusted recipients and the invitation service are unavailable.
Member and invitation status cannot be loaded. No recipients or invitations are fabricated.
Staff access is not available yet. These role descriptions do not grant permissions. Only the queue owner can manage this queue.
Intended for operating a counter. This role cannot be assigned yet.
Intended for managing a queue. This role cannot be assigned yet.
Intended for viewing queue information. This role cannot be assigned yet.
Trusted recipient unavailable. No address or fictional colleague is selected.
An actual invitation or member is required to view status, change a role or revoke access. No pending, accepted or revoked outcome is claimed.
The service is still unavailable. Your local draft is unchanged.
Choose a service before reviewing a local draft.
Local draft only. Up to 4,000 characters per field; this is not a group-size limit.
